title: Bridge drops after receiver acceptance
description: The receiver accepts but the bridge drops before the caller is confirmed connected.
callerVisible: The caller is kept on the line (or called back on the approved route) while the transfer is retried; never told they are connected when they are not.

registry.injectionPoint: the bridge drops after receiver acceptance (LiveKit/SIP warm transfer)

postconditions: The attempt fails after receiver acceptance and is never recorded COMPLETED without CALLER_CONFIRMED_CONNECTED
The next staffed route from trusted configuration is invoked; the caller is never abandoned
TRANSFERRED is recorded only with receiver acceptance and a verified connection
